model_rule: NEVER hardcode project-specific paths, skill names, asset names, or domain concepts into the framework (packages/). The framework must remain generic.

findings.gap: The downloadExampleFromGitHub() function hardcodes the specific GitHub organization (myanlabs) and repository name (converge) in URL construction. This embeds project-specific identity into framework code.
findings.evidence: commands-add.ts line 615: const url = `https://api.github.com/repos/myanlabs/converge/contents/examples/${exampleName}/.converge`; and line 628: `git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/myanlabs/converge.git` -- both hardcode the org/repo name in executable code, not documentation.
findings.correction: Parameterize the repository URL, either through a function parameter, environment variable (CONVERGE_EXAMPLES_REPO), or project config. The framework should know how to download examples generically, not where they live.
findings.test_to_write: tests/cli/commands-add-repo-config.test.ts -- test that downloadExampleFromGitHub accepts a configurable repoUrl and uses it instead of the hardcoded myanlabs/converge default.

findings.gap: JSDoc examples in the framework client API use project-specific .stitch/ paths and stitch-generate skill names. While documentation, these embed project-specific domain concepts into framework source files.
findings.evidence: converge-client.ts line 13: client.readFile('.stitch/screens.json'), line 18: skills: ['stitch-generate']. task-definition.ts has 20+ similar occurrences throughout JSDoc.
findings.correction: Replace stitch-specific names in JSDoc examples with generic placeholders (e.g., 'my-skill', '.project/data.json') that do not reference any specific example project.
findings.test_to_write: tests/framework-doc-generic.test.ts -- grep-based test that JSDoc examples in packages/ do not contain stitch-specific paths or skill names.

findings.gap: Test fixture strings in health check templates embed .stitch/ paths, setting a precedent for mixing project-specific concepts into framework internals.
findings.evidence: health-checks.ts line 195: 'Expected .stitch/designs/X.html but found .stitch/designs/X/design.html', line 338: 'Update outputs to: .stitch/designs/{screenId}/design.html'
findings.correction: Replace stitch-specific paths in test fixtures with generic paths like '.output/results/file.txt'.
findings.test_to_write: tests/framework-no-stitch.test.ts -- ensure no .stitch/ string literals appear in non-JSDoc framework code.
